facts.fact: iXAfrica Data Centres' Nairobi One campus is operating as a carrier-neutral colocation and cloud data centre in Nairobi, hosting Paratus's new point of presence for Paratus Cloud (operator iXAfrica; no opening date given, so dated by the publication date 2025-09-12).
iXAfrica states its in-service Nairobi facility has a Tier III design (operator's own statement, no certifying body named) with 99.999% uptime; dated by publication date 2025-09-12.
